lore.stat.might.what: Every hit you land is multiplied by this, straight away, for every weapon you carry. The bigger it gets, the shorter goblins' lives.
lore.stat.meleeMight.what: Extra damage for melee weapons only. Swords and spears, this one's yours.
lore.stat.rangedMight.what: Extra damage for bows, crossbows and anything thrown. Aim true.
lore.stat.magicMight.what: Extra damage for spells and staffs only. A wizard's favourite number.
lore.stat.bossMight.what: Extra damage against bosses only, so the big ones stop feeling so big.
lore.stat.levelMight.what: Damage that grows with every level you gain. Survive longer, hit harder.
lore.stat.levelMight.calc: Each hero level adds this much damage, for the first 40 levels.
lore.stat.armor.what: Armour stops this much damage from every hit you take, so small hits can't hurt you at all.
lore.stat.armor.calc: Taken off each hit, in flat damage. Some attacks ignore it.
lore.stat.maxHp.what: Your hitpoints. Each point is a mistake you're allowed to make.
lore.stat.maxHp.calc: The hero starts with 25, and this percentage is added on top.
lore.stat.regen.what: Hitpoints you win back every minute without eating anything. Slow, steady and very smug.
lore.stat.regen.calc: Spread evenly over the minute, so you heal a little all the time.
lore.stat.cooldown.what: Weapon speed: every weapon waits less between attacks, so everything swings sooner.
lore.stat.cooldown.calc: Shortens each weapon's wait by this much. It stops helping at 60%.
lore.stat.area.what: Makes your attacks bigger: reach, radius, splash. More swing, more enemies per swing.
lore.stat.auraArea.what: Extra size for aura attacks only. The ring around you grows teeth.
lore.stat.speed.what: How fast your projectiles fly. Shots land before the enemy knows it.
lore.stat.duration.what: Your effects last longer: venom, burning, freezes, orbiting runes and the like.
lore.stat.amount.what: Extra projectiles on every weapon that fires them. One more arrow is a lot more arrow.
lore.stat.amount.calc: Added to each weapon's own number of projectiles.
lore.stat.moveSpeed.what: How fast you run. Marvellous for kiting, rude for chasers.
lore.stat.magnet.what: How far loot is pulled to you: bones, coins, experience. Lazy-collector mode.
lore.stat.luck.what: Better odds on food and caskets, and rarer picks on level ups. Fortune has noticed you.
lore.stat.luck.calc: Multiplies the chance of a drop and of a rarer pick.
lore.stat.growth.what: Everything you kill is worth more experience, so levels come sooner.
lore.stat.greed.what: Coins you find are worth more, and coins are the ones you keep.
lore.stat.revival.what: Extra lives. When you'd fall you get up again with some hitpoints instead. Respect the second chance.
lore.stat.reroll.what: Rerolls: don't like the picks on a level up? Shuffle them.
lore.stat.banish.what: Banishes: cross a pick off for good, so it never turns up again this run.
lore.stat.thorns.what: Recoil: whatever hits you in melee takes this much damage back. Rude, but fair.
lore.stat.thorns.calc: Dealt back to the enemy that hit you, per hit.
lore.stat.healChance.what: A chance to heal a few hitpoints each time you hit something. Fighting as a way to eat.
lore.stat.healChance.calc: Rolled on each hit, at most once a second.
lore.stat.meleeKnockback.what: Melee hits push enemies back further. More personal space for you.
lore.stat.meleeSpeed.what: Melee weapons only: swing more often.
lore.stat.weaponSlots.what: How many weapons you can carry at once. More toys.
lore.stat.passiveSlots.what: How many passives you can carry at once.
lore.stat.powerUpRate.what: More power-ups fall from enemies. Free presents.
lore.weapon.damage.what: How hard each hit lands, before your damage stats multiply it.
lore.weapon.damage.calc: Grows with the weapon's levels. Rarer picks also earn it a damage bonus.
lore.weapon.attacks.what: How many times it fires a second.
lore.weapon.attacks.calc: One over the weapon's wait between attacks, which your weapon speed shortens.
lore.weapon.knockback.what: How far a hit shoves enemies back. Keeps the crowd at arm's length.
lore.weapon.knockback.calc: Melee knockback stretches it for melee weapons.
lore.weapon.projectiles.what: How many shots it fires at once.
lore.weapon.projectiles.calc: Your projectiles stat adds more on top.
lore.weapon.targets.what: How many enemies each cast picks out.
lore.weapon.pierces.what: How many enemies a shot passes through before it stops.
lore.weapon.venom.what: Poison damage every second on whatever it hits.
lore.weapon.venom.calc: Keeps ticking for as long as the venom lasts.
lore.weapon.venom_lasts.what: How long the venom keeps ticking.
lore.weapon.freezes_for.what: How long enemies stand frozen after it hits.
lore.weapon.burns_for.what: How long the ground burns where it lands.
lore.weapon.weakens_for.what: How long enemies stay weakened after it hits.
lore.weapon.sides.what: How many ways it swings: 2 is front and back.
lore.weapon.reach.what: How far in front of you it hits.
lore.weapon.arc.what: How wide the swing is. A wider arc catches more of the crowd.
lore.weapon.bounces.what: How many times a thrown axe ricochets to a new target.
lore.weapon.splash.what: How far the blast spreads round where a shot lands.
lore.weapon.speed.calc: Your projectile speed stat adds to it.
lore.weapon.lasts.what: How long its runes stay out before they're gone.
lore.weapon.spin_speed.what: How fast its runes circle you.
lore.calc.percent: Every source adds up, and the total scales the base: the base times (1 + the total).
lore.calc.flat: Every source adds up as a flat amount.
lore.bonus.what: Extra damage this weapon has earned. Every rarer pick you take on it adds a slice.
lore.bonus.calc: Added on top of its damage. Some is carried over from what it evolved from.
lore.passive.calc: Each time you pick it on a level up it adds again, and a rarer pick adds more.
lore.power.base: Right at the base: nothing's adding to it yet.
lore.power.flat: A fresh hero has none. You have {value}.
